name: clor
description: Clor for Codex. Claws that automate work in the background or on a schedule, plus a toolkit for web research, AI text, image, and audio inference, social platform research, email, cloud files, encrypted secrets, weather, and bulk domain name checking.

interface.shortDescription: Claws that automate work in the background or on a schedule, plus web research, AI text/image/audio inference, social, email, cloud files, secrets, weather, and bulk domain checking
interface.longDescription: Clor gives Codex claws, subagents that automate work in the background or on a schedule using the same MCP servers, CLIs, skills, and tools Codex already has, so anything you can ask Codex to do once a claw can do unattended. It also adds a toolkit for working outside the repo. Run web research with webgrep, searching pages, news, images, and videos, then scrape, parse, map, crawl, and screenshot URLs. Delegate text, image, and audio inference across Claude, GPT, Gemini, and ElevenLabs (text generation, image generation and editing, text-to-speech, transcription, music, sound effects, voice isolation, voice change). Read what people are saying on Hacker News and other social platforms. Read, search, send, and triage email over IMAP and SMTP. Use persistent cloud file storage with personal and shared drives, ACL grants, and public links. Store and retrieve encrypted JSON secrets scoped to a user or shared across an account. Look up weather and location data, and bulk-classify domain names as available, taken, or unknown across hundreds of TLDs.
defaultPrompt: Create a claw that emails me a Hacker News digest every weekday morning.
Use Clor to find recent news on a topic.
Use Clor to find a YouTube tutorial.
Use Clor to scrape a page as markdown.
Use Clor to extract text from a PDF.
Use Clor to take a full-page screenshot of a site.
Use Clor to search Hacker News for discussion on a topic.
Use Clor to ask Claude or GPT a question with extended thinking.
Use Clor to generate or edit an image with GPT or Gemini nano banana.
Use Clor to transcribe an audio file to text with Whisper.
